messages:
Maria: quick sync — draft blog is ready for a final scrub. publish target = Wed 10am PT. need: 1) one-line hero that can survive legal, 2) 2 benchmark bullets (latency/cost), 3) webinar CTA + landing routing, 4) sales-ready FAQ. can folks do a pass by EOD tomorrow? :hourglass: 
Jamal: on it. i'll wire up the benchmark numbers from last week's perf run. leaning toward '30% lower per-token cost vs baseline on 8k seq' — will confirm.
Leah: i'll take hero and visuals. can we pick the hero frame: product-as-inference-runtime vs product-as-cost-saver? i think visuals differ.
Aisha: webinar CTA — we should gate with a short checklist on landing page. i can draft HubSpot form fields. also recommend a short 20-min demo + 10-min q&a.
Sam: sales asked for a short FAQ paragraph about data residency and single-tenant options. i'll draft and ping legal.
Ken: can you drop the legal draft now? i'll do a quick pass but need precise language for the hero claim. :wave:
Maria: attached doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/pulse-briefing-v3 (please comment inline).
Jamal: benchmark snippet i'm proposing: 1) 99th-p99 latency = 45ms on p4d for small chat flow; 2) inference unit cost = $0.0032/token after batching and KV cache. 
Leah: hero direction — i prefer framing as 'Predictable inference at production scale' vs cost-only. visuals: two-pane (latency vs cost) with small icons. i'll upload comps by noon.
Aisha: HubSpot routing snippet i'm thinking (please confirm with Ops):
```
form: inbound_pulse_launch
fields: [email, company, use_case, region]
utm_source: newsletter
route: sales-east, sales-eu based on region
notify: sales@redwood.com
```
Aisha: also propose we tag leads with 'pulse-launch-2026' so SDRs can prioritize.
Sam: re: FAQ — here's a 2-line draft for data residency: 'Redwood Inference offers Dedicated and Private deployments with region-specific controls. Data in Dedicated/Private stays in customer-controlled networks; hosted API offers encrypted-at-rest and in-transit controls.' ken, ok for legal quick-pass?
Ken: short answer: tweak 'stays' -> 'is retained' and add a pointer to our compliance page. otherwise fine. i'll add a 1-sentence caveat about third-party plugins.
Maria: great. can someone stitch a 200-word intro and a 3-bullet TL;DR for the top? that helps the newsletter snippet.
Jamal: i'll draft TL;DR with two benchmark bullets + one line about rollout options.
Leah: uploaded mock: https://design.redwood/assets/pulse-hero-v2 — feedback welcome. small ask: use brand blue for latency pane, not green.
OpsBot: Document updated by Jamal at 1768004870 — comments: 6 unresolved.
Aisha: tagging @Sam @Ken — can you confirm lead routing rule by EOD? sales ops needs final mapping.
Sam: confirm. sales-east -> EMEA fallback for 'row' missing? also want a 'vip' rule: if company size >1000 set owner to AE-Enterprise. i'll send mapping.
Ken: legal quick-pass done — comments inline on hero claim at doc. Maria, please resolve phrasing before publish.
Maria: will resolve hero and publish updated doc by midday tomorrow. final checklist for Tuesday: legal signed, design assets uploaded, HubSpot routing in place, sales FAQ ready, newsletter snippet + 1-line subject.
Leah: tiny copy nit: change 'predictable' to 'consistent' in headline for tone.
Jamal: benchmark numbers locked in — updated doc with source table.
Maria: thanks team. if nothing else, i'll post the final for a 1-hr review block tomorrow 2pm PT. :thumbsup:
